model.name: SatQueryOpticalSARNet-v1.0
model.architecture: SatQueryOpticalSARNet (Dual-Encoder Fusion Network with Channel Attention)

cross_modal_coregistration_guardrails.rationale: Keypoint descriptors (SIFT/ORB) fail catastrophically across Optical and SAR due to radical radiometric inversion and speckle noise. Verification relies on GeoTIFF bounding box intersection when georeferenced, or Normalized Mutual Information (NMI) and Sobel Gradient Directional Correlation for unreferenced imagery.

true_pair_test.pair: Mumbai Cartosat Optical vs RISAT-1 C-Band SAR

disparate_pair_test.pair: Bengaluru Optical vs Mumbai RISAT-1 SAR

modality_detection_guardrail.method: Multi-spectral statistics: inter-channel Pearson correlation, saturation variance, and speckle coefficient of variation
modality_detection_guardrail.verification: Correctly categorizes Cartosat/Sentinel-2 as optical and RISAT/Sentinel-1 as SAR
modality_detection_guardrail.agent_guardrail: Rejects single-image or multi-image queries if requested modality contradicts detected imagery

cross_modal_section.fusion_benefit: SAR penetrates persistent monsoon cloud cover to delineate open water and coastal outlines while optical spectral reflectance delineates complex vegetation.
